name: salicylic acid + zinc pyrithione
uses: A gentle antifungal face cream designed for daily care of sensitive skin prone to seborrheic dermatitis, fungal ance, folliculitis & Mild Psoriasis.
otcwarn: Do not use it on children under 3 years of age. You have concerns about skin irritation or if symptoms persist beyond 4 weeks. Irritation occurs or if there is no improvement within 4 weeks.
